In English, global in scope, academic in standard and readable by anyone.

## Library

A curated, filterable database of academic and policy literature on populism, built for literature reviews. Filter by how populism is defined and by what it is studied alongside. Every entry links to its DOI or to an open-access copy.

[Open the Library](library/index.qmd)

## Monitor

A monthly issue on what populist actors did around the world: six regional roundups, one theme in focus, new research and what is coming up. Every claim links to its source.

::: {#latest-monitor}
:::

::: {.pv-pending}

:::

[All issues of the Monitor](monitor/index.qmd)

## Commentary

Short scholarly commentary on populism and populist actors, written by researchers and reviewed by the editor. Published quarterly.

## Newsletter

One email for each new issue: a short summary and a link. [About the newsletter](newsletter/index.qmd)
